redCandidate.publicEntry: node scripts/aios.mjs internal browser cdp-start, which installs the macOS launch-agent policy
redCandidate.setup: Render the AIOS-managed CDP launch-agent plist for the default port and assert that login and process-exit events cannot launch or revive Chrome without an explicit CDP start request.

args: browser CDP launch agent only starts Chrome on an explicit request

redCandidate.expected: The generated plist does not set RunAtLoad or KeepAlive to true, while explicit cdp-start remains the action that kickstarts Chrome.
redCandidate.observed: The generated plist sets both RunAtLoad and KeepAlive to true.
redCandidate.failureReason: The AIOS-managed launchd policy explicitly starts Chrome at login and restarts it after exit, so browser launch is not gated by an explicit user browser action.
